CHAPTER.VERS: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph, a song. In Judah is God known: His name is great in Israel.
In Salem also is his tabernacle, And his dwelling-place in Zion.
There he broke the arrows of the bow; The shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.
Glorious are you [and] excellent, From the everlasting mountains.
The stouthearted are made a spoil, They have slept their sleep; And none of the men of might have found their hands.
At your rebuke, O God of Jacob, Both chariot and horse are cast into a deep sleep.
You, even you, are to be awed; And who may stand in your sight when once you are angry?
You caused sentence to be heard from heaven; The earth feared, and was still,
When God arose to judgment, To save all the meek of the earth. Selah.
Surely the wrath of man will praise you: The residue of wrath you will gird on you.
He will cut off the spirit of leaders: He is awesome to the kings of the earth.
